selectedPolicy: No repository code execution by default; no repository code launch at M3.
Providers/tools use the existing per-platform confinement proposal: Linux Landlock/seccomp with network denial; macOS Seatbelt network and outside-scratch write restrictions.
Unavailable confinement means explicit disclosure and ordinary analysis fallback; untrusted pull requests require container guidance.
Available confinement whose application fails means refuse the launch.
Future repository-code execution retains separate RepoExecutionGrantV2 and the existing M5-EX confinement/authorization/compatibility requirements; no such execution is enabled by this decision.
